Subject: SOC2/DPA onboarding — can we split legal + tech?

Hi Priyom,

We’re getting close to procurement and the security review at FinMap. Legal wants to see a quick DPA redline discussion and sign-off separate from the technical walkthrough (pen test / SOC 2 controls tour). Would Redwood be able to run a split session: ~20 minutes for legal (DPA+contract touches) and ~40 minutes for technical (controls, pen-test scope, evidence handover)? Prefer next week (US mornings) if possible.

I attached the SOC2 questionnaire we started answering — can you confirm you can cover the highlighted controls? Also looping in procurement for timing.

Thanks,

- 20 min: Legal & procurement (Priyom + Laura) — focused on DPA redlines, KMS/HSM options, retention, and contract timeline.
- 40 min: Controls deep-dive (Ben + Security SME) — demo of audit trails, KV cache retention, evidence transfer (SFTP / secure Share), and pen-test scope & vendor constraints.

Availability: Monday 2026-08-24 and Tuesday 2026-08-25 mornings (US EDT) look clear for our team. Can you do 08:30–09:30 ET on either day (we’ll split the first 20 / remaining 40)? If procurement needs a separate DocuSign preview we can share the redline ahead of time.

I’ve pasted a quick checklist below of the items we’ll prepare if you confirm the slot:
- Draft DPA redline (we’ll email before the legal block)
- KMS/HSM whitepaper + options for key separation
- Evidence transfer options and an SFTP test account (if you want a dry run)
- SOC2 in-scope controls mapping (highlighted sections from your questionnaire)

Will loop Ben and Laura to confirm the technical SME and legal owner.

—Priyom
